what_happened: Both dependency fronts had already landed the two facts this dispatch would otherwise have had to derive: stab_iff_ofut_opast / stab_iff_opast_ofut compile the product factorization of the stability cluster, and paste_valid lands its object-language form (the PS pasting axiom). The automaton verdict could be built on compiled lemmas instead of paper sketches.

PlusLCSchema.lean's module docstring states 'LCU is the n = 1 instance of lcN'. Report 03 section 2.3 defines LCU as the until-form with two parameters and the untl connective; lcN at n=1 is the F-form with one parameter and no untl. The candidate system's until-form ingredient is therefore neither landed nor correctly recorded.

The landed omega_chain dropped the source probe's segment-property parameter P (recorded as 'unused'), but P is exactly the hook report 03 section 2.3 names as LCU's compiled semantic core. The until-form's core is now only in specs/evidence/, not in the library.
